visualCharacteristics.purpose: dismissible site notice (e.g. unsupported browser warning) with info icon, message, link and close button

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell: message text with optional link; optional second cell with a custom icon image

usage: Site-wide notices at the top of the home page and banking landing pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for short dismissible notices. Dismissal is remembered for the browser session. Not for promotional banners.
